modmenu.descriptionTranslation.tweakify-: A tool for adjusting and optimizing vanilla mechanics
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.lang: Language used by this mod's interface: Chinese, English, Russian, French. Only takes effect when Follow System Language is off.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.foll: When on, the game's current language is used and the language selection above is ignored.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.reme: Remember the last selected tab (All / General / Functions / Modified / Fixes / Optimizations) and reopen the config screen on that tab.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.bloc: Prevents restricted offhand items from taking over while the use key remains held after the main-hand item runs out. An optional hotkey toggles this on/off.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.open: Hotkey that opens (or closes) the Tweakify Mod config screen. Default: G + C.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.inte: Also blocks block interactions while offhand fallback interception is active. When off, placing the offhand block item is still intercepted, but interactive blocks (doors, levers, buttons, chests, etc.) keep working.
Also blocks offhand entity interaction while offhand fallback interception is active.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.mini: When enabled, one left click mines only one block; holding the attack key is intercepted after the first block until released and pressed again.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.useC: Master switch for the right click interaction cooldown. When off, the main/offhand use cooldowns do nothing.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.main: When the master switch is on, main-hand items can only be used once per right click.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.offh: When the master switch is on, offhand items can only be used once per right click.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Keeps normal movement speed while using items (eating, drawing a bow, blocking with a shield, etc.).
Removes the camera shake caused by taking damage; other camera effects such as walking bob are unaffected.
Stops horizontal movement immediately when the movement keys are released while flying in creative or spectator mode.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.flig: When flight drift removal is enabled, releasing the jump/sneak keys also stops vertical movement immediately.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Entities no longer get the red hurt overlay; the death tint and white hurt flash stay vanilla.
Master switch: stops entities from changing dimensions through portals. The child switches control the nether and end portals and whether their blacklists apply.
Nether portal interception switch. It also controls the nether blacklist: when on, an empty blacklist blocks every entity and a non-empty one blocks only the listed entities.
End portal interception switch. It also controls the end blacklist: when on, an empty blacklist blocks every entity and a non-empty one blocks only the listed entities.
Removes the underwater mining speed penalty.
Removes the extra mining slowdown while not on the ground.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.high: Outlines nearby single-layer bedrock (no bedrock above or below) to help locate weak spots in the Nether ceiling. Scans a 32-block radius and refreshes 6 times per second.
Maximum number of single-layer bedrock markers shown at once (1 ~ 256); nearest markers are kept when exceeded.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.barr: Shows nearby barrier blocks with the same vanilla block-marker particles as holding a barrier item. Particles are locked to the block center and cooled per block, so they do not drift or overlap. An optional hotkey toggles this. Scans a 32-block radius and refreshes 6 times per second.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.dura: Shows durability text above the item durability bar in inventories; hidden at full durability. The color turns green, white, yellow and red as durability drops. An optional hotkey toggles this.
What the durability text shows: percentage, or the remaining durability (current amount only, without the initial maximum).
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Lets the grindstone remove curse enchantments (vanilla keeps them). Single-player/LAN only.
Right-clicking a multi-layer snow block with a shovel removes only one layer instead of the whole block and drops one snowball. Single-player/LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.fixB: Dirt paths use a 15/16 collision height, so boats can get stuck on the 1/16 step when leaving a path. This only gives boats a 1/16 step-up height without changing block collision, so placement, friction and sliding speed are unaffected. Single-player/LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.elyt: While gliding, using a firework locks out further fireworks until the current boost ends. An optional hotkey toggles this.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Superflat worlds no longer spawn slimes. Single-player/LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.bett: Invisible entities no longer emit potion particles, and their equipment and third-person held items are hidden as well.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Taking the result from a smithing table keeps the template instead of consuming it. Single-player/LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.chat: Hold the left mouse button and drag over chat messages to select text, then press Ctrl+C to copy.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.atta: Shows a translucent blue wireframe attack range around mobs and players. An optional hotkey toggles this.
Flat: double ring wireframe on the ground; Sphere: latitude/longitude wireframe sphere centered on the entity.
Blue wireframe: no OIT, better performance. Translucent filled: fuller look, but the transparent pass has a fixed cost and may lower FPS.
Whether to show the local player's own attack range; when off, only other mobs and players are shown.
Maximum distance (blocks) to collect attack ranges, 8 ~ 128.
Maximum number of attack ranges shown at once, 8 ~ 256; nearest entities are kept when exceeded.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.nigh: Night vision fades out smoothly instead of flickering near the end.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.ench: Show enchantment levels as Arabic numerals (1, 2, 3...) instead of Roman numerals.
tweakify-mod.config.lists.comment.restri: Item IDs that offhand fallback interception prevents from being used automatically. Defaults to all light-source items.
tweakify-mod.config.lists.comment.nether: Only applies while Disable Nether Portal Teleport is on: empty blocks every entity, non-empty blocks only the listed entity IDs.
tweakify-mod.config.lists.comment.endPor: Only applies while Disable End Portal Teleport is on: empty blocks every entity, non-empty blocks only the listed entity IDs.
tweakify-mod.config.lists.comment.endGat: Only applies while Disable End Gateway Teleport is on: empty blocks every entity, non-empty blocks only the listed entity IDs.
tweakify-mod.config.lists.comment.useIte: Items that keep the vanilla use slowdown (item ID list).
tweakify-mod.config.lists.comment.mainHa: Item IDs affected by the main-hand use cooldown. Defaults to all interactable items.
tweakify-mod.config.lists.comment.offhan: Item IDs affected by the offhand use cooldown. Defaults to all interactable items.
tweakify-mod.config.lists.comment.attack: Mob/player IDs whose attack range should be shown; empty means all mobs and players.
tweakify-mod.config.highlight.comment.en: Draws a glowing outline for configured entities. Also requires one highlight preset to be enabled and the entity ID to be in its list.
tweakify-mod.config.highlight.comment.hi: Preset 1 switch. The three presets are mutually exclusive; enabling one disables the others.
Preset 2 switch. The three presets are mutually exclusive; enabling one disables the others.
Preset 3 switch. The three presets are mutually exclusive; enabling one disables the others.
Entity IDs highlighted by preset 1, including dropped item entities such as minecraft:item.
Entity IDs highlighted by preset 2, including dropped item entities such as minecraft:item.
Entity IDs highlighted by preset 3, including dropped item entities such as minecraft:item.
tweakify-mod.command.item.page_out_of_ra: Page out of range, %s pages total
tweakify-mod.command.item.reset_done: Reset to light-source items, %s items total
tweakify-mod.command.save_failed: Failed to write config file; changes reverted, check the log
tweakify-mod.command.profile.saved_with_: Saved profile: %s; previous profiles backed up to %s
tweakify-mod.command.profile.save_failed: Failed to save profile: %s; previous profiles backed up to %s
tweakify-mod.command.profile.list_empty: No profiles yet; use /tweakify profile save <name> to create one
tweakify-mod.command.profile.broken: Profile file is corrupted; check the log and retry
tweakify-mod.command.profile.file_broken: Profile file is corrupted; cannot list profiles, check the log and retry
tweakify-mod.command.profile.file_unread: Failed to read the profile file; check the log and retry
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.item: How long dropped items last, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). The default 6000 is the vanilla 5 minutes; the slider ranges from 60 to 36000. Single player / LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.copy: Master switch for copying object IDs (off by default). The hotkey on this row toggles the switch; the actual copy action uses the 'Copy Target ID Hotkey' child entry.
tweakify-mod.message.copy_id.no_target: Nothing targeted; aim at a block, an entity or an item to copy its ID
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.copy: Press to copy the ID of the block/entity under the crosshair, or the item hovered in a container screen, to the clipboard, and show a clickable ID in chat. Requires 'Copy Object ID' to be enabled.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.wart: A single nether wart block in a crafting grid yields 9 nether wart. Single-player/LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.elyt: Keep gliding in water instead of switching to fluid movement.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Hide the purple overlay, camera spin and portal sound while inside a nether portal.
Sleep from any distance; the 'too far away' message is skipped. Single-player/LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.iron: Empty minecarts pick up iron golems on contact so they can ride along. Single player / LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.conn: Show the outline of the whole door, bed, double chest, tall plant, etc. when targeted, similar to Bedrock Edition.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.cust: Master switch for customizing the block outline width and color. The children below control width, palette and color mode. Vanilla high-contrast outlines are kept when that option is enabled.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.bloc: Block outline line width (adjustable with the slider). Some GPUs or render backends may clamp it to 1.
Animation speed percentage for Rainbow and Pulse modes (10 to 400; 100 is the default; higher is faster).
Color used by the 'Palette' color mode.
Palette: fixed color above; Rainbow: cycles the hue over time; Pulse: periodically changes brightness.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.bett: Placing a block directly replaces flowers, grass and similar plants. Single-player/LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.item: Only items dropped by players use the lifetime above; mob drops and block drops keep the vanilla 5 minutes.
How long experience orbs last, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). The default 6000 is the vanilla 5 minutes; it shares the same range as item drops. Single player / LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.copy: Format of the text written to the clipboard: plain ID, with a type prefix (item/block/entity), or with a stack count.
Close the container screen automatically after copying an item ID from it.
Show a clickable ID in chat after copying; when off, the ID is only written to the clipboard.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: On by default: prevent entities from teleporting through end gateways. Requires the master switch above; the blacklist below blocks everything when empty and only the listed entity IDs when non-empty.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.shov: Drop 1 snowball when removing a single snow layer; when off, shovelling drops nothing.
Removing a single snow layer costs shovel durability like normal mining; when off it costs nothing.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.bett: Invisible entities no longer emit potion effect particles.
In third person, invisible entities also hide armor, capes and held items.
An invisible llama also hides the carpet and decorations it wears.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.chat: Background highlight color used for selected chat text.
Copy the selection automatically when the left button is released, instead of pressing Ctrl+C.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.nigh: Length of the smooth fade before night vision ends, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second); range 20 to 400.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Hide the translucent purple overlay while standing inside a portal.
Stop the camera from spinning around the view while standing inside a portal.
Mute the portal ambient loop and the teleport sound.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.bett: Plants that can be replaced directly: flowers and grass (flowers, saplings, tall grass), flowers plus crops, or every non-solid plant.

Makes bone meal work on sugar cane and one-block-high flowers like Bedrock Edition: sugar cane grows to full height at once, and a flower grows a patch of the same flower around it. Single player / LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.bone: Using bone meal on sugar cane instantly grows the whole plant to its maximum height of 3 blocks, consuming one bone meal.
Using bone meal on a one-block-high flower grows a patch of the same flower around it, like Bedrock Edition (wither roses excluded).
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.dura: Only show durability text on hotbar slots, not in the inventory grid.
Only show durability text below this remaining percentage; range 0 to 100, where 0 always shows it.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Master switch for full-screen overlays such as powder snow, lava and underwater; the children below control each one.
Hide the frosted border overlay while inside powder snow.
Hide the orange-red full-screen overlay while inside lava.
Hide the blue water overlay while underwater.
Sprinting no longer widens the field of view; speed potions, flight and bow drawing keep their vanilla effect.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.keep: Bedrock-like behaviour: switching items while mining no longer resets the progress, so the same block keeps breaking.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Landing on farmland no longer turns it back into dirt. Single player / LAN only.
The anvil no longer says 'Too Expensive' at 40 levels; the result can be taken directly, even with too few levels (levels never drop below 0). Single player / LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.remo: Ignores enchantment exclusivity when merging items in an anvil, allowing conflicting enchantments such as Sharpness and Smite on the same item. Single player/LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.ench: Adds a description line for each enchantment in item tooltips (enchanted books included).
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.visi: Shows future-level (locked) villager trades in the trading screen; they unlock in order as the villager levels up. Single player/LAN only (the server must generate the trade data).
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.scro: Remember where a list was scrolled to and return there when the screen is reopened; on by default, the children control MaLiLib config screens and Mod Menu separately. Kept for the current session only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.mali: Remember the scroll position of MaLiLib config screens, including this mod's config screen.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.modM: Remember the scroll position of the Mod Menu mod list; has no effect when Mod Menu is not installed.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.swor: While holding a sword, plants under the crosshair are ignored so the entity behind is targeted; left click no longer breaks the plant first. Plants with collision (such as sweet berry bushes) are unaffected.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.pick: Middle-click while aiming at water or lava to get the matching bucket (creative puts it in the hotbar, survival switches to the bucket you already have). Single player / LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.forc: Skips the world loading screen text and progress bar (background kept) while the world loads in the background; the screen closes normally when loading finishes. Sub-settings can keep the screen, close it entirely, or speed up resource pack loading.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Hides incompatible markers in the resource pack screen and skips the confirmation prompt when enabling an incompatible pack. Resource packs only; data packs are unaffected.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.cutT: Which held items trigger cut-through: sword only, sword and axe, or any held item.
Plants that can be cut through: flowers and grass (flowers, saplings, tall grass), flowers and crops, or every non-solid plant.
While sneaking, vanilla behaviour applies and left click breaks the plant first.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.surv: In survival, middle-click a block, fluid or entity to switch to the matching item already in your inventory; otherwise vanilla behaviour. Single player / LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.quic: Hover an item held in your inventory or a container over a lava bucket or flint and steel, then right-click to burn it. Single player/LAN destroys the item; on remote servers it is dropped instead.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.auto: Automatically steps up 1-block-high blocks like a horse. Client-side local player only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.bett: Improves movement in climbable blocks (faster descend while looking down, faster ascend, jump from ground, etc.). Sub-settings can be toggled individually; use the separate "No Slowdown Passing Climbables" option in the Modified tab for horizontal no-slowdown.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.forc: Enable the master switch and bind the crawl key below, then hold it to force the crawling pose and fit through one-block-high spaces. Single player / LAN host only.
Hold this key to crawl and release it to stand back up; requires the Active Crawling switch.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.clim: Running past ladders, vines and other climbable blocks no longer clamps your horizontal speed when you only brush their edge; vanilla climbing up and down is unchanged.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.keep: Prevents placing a torch when only one is left in your inventory. Single player/LAN only (remote servers cannot be intercepted).
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.pigl: Automatically swaps golden armor from your inventory onto your body while a piglin is nearby, and swaps it back when they leave. Only works in survival or adventure mode.
Auto: when no golden armor is worn, equips one piece from your inventory (whichever you have); you can also limit the swap to the helmet, chestplate, leggings or boots.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.chat: Keeps the text typed in the chat screen when it is closed without sending, and restores it the next time. Sent messages are not kept.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: No fog or blue tint underwater (separate from the underwater overlay above).
No orange fog inside lava.
No white fog inside powder snow.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.farm: Only players stop trampling farmland; animals and villagers still do.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.mini: Attacking entities is also limited to once per left click (shares the hold cycle with mining).
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.dime: Only block players' dimension travel; other entities still use portals normally.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.flat: No slimes in any world type, not just superflat.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.elyt: Minimum interval between fireworks in ticks; 0 waits for the current boost to end.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.scro: Write scroll positions to the config file so they survive a game restart.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.nigh: Smooth: slower at both ends; Linear: even fade.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.elyt: Only keep gliding in water; lava still sinks like vanilla.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Prevents removing the item once equipped
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Attacks ignore part of the target's armor
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc: Sets targets on fire when hit
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces fire damage and burn time
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Freezes water while walking on it
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Deals extra damage to aquatic mobs
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Increases movement speed on soul sand
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: Creates a wind burst on mace hit
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Summons lightning on the target during a thunderstorm
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.prof: Open the config profile editor to save, load, or delete whole-config profiles.
tweakify-mod.gui.profile_editor.title: Profile Editor
tweakify-mod.gui.profile_editor.name: Profile name
tweakify-mod.gui.profile_editor.empty: No profiles yet; enter a name and save the current config.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.forc: Closes the loading screen entirely (may briefly fall through the world). Only applies when "Force Close Loading Screen" is enabled.
Does not skip the loading screen text and progress bar (background and world still load normally).
Removes the resource pack loading screen fade-in/out and removes the overlay immediately (the game still enters after resources finish loading).
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.stat: Shows the remaining time under each status effect icon on the HUD (seconds / m:ss / 2h05 / 2d05). Infinite effects are not shown. An optional hotkey toggles this on/off.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.neth: Adjusts how long players wait in a nether portal. The sub-options make survival teleport instantly or make creative wait like survival. An optional hotkey toggles this on/off.
Survival and adventure players teleport through nether portals immediately, like creative mode.
Creative players wait the same delay as survival players instead of teleporting instantly.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.parr: Like Bedrock Edition: a parrot on your shoulder keeps dancing while a nearby jukebox is playing, instead of staying still.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.bett: Changes the bold glyph offset from vanilla 1.0 to 0.5 pixels (same as MCPatcher/OptiFine), making bold text clearer instead of smudged.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.disa: Mobs in the list will not spawn through natural, structure, patrol, reinforcement, jockey, raid, evoker-summoned, or spawner world spawning. An empty list disables this feature. Single player/LAN only.
Mob IDs that should not spawn (e.g. minecraft:zombie). An empty list disables this feature.
When enabled, player-created mobs from spawn eggs, commands, breeding, etc. are not blocked by this list. Player-built triggers (e.g. iron golems, withers) are always allowed.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.peac: Allows listed monsters to spawn and stay in Peaceful difficulty. An empty list disables this feature. Single player/LAN only.
Mob IDs handled by the Peaceful Mode Monsters feature (e.g. minecraft:zombie). An empty list disables this feature.
tweakify-mod.config.general.name.peacefu: Allow Specified Mob Spawning in Peaceful
tweakify-mod.config.general.prettyName.p: Allow Specified Mob Spawning in Peaceful
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.peac: Listed monsters can spawn in Peaceful difficulty through natural spawning, spawners, trial spawners, and nether portals, and will not be removed by the difficulty. Trial spawners require all spawn potentials to be listed.
Listed monsters will not target or attack players while the difficulty is Peaceful.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.mini: Throttles MiniHUD HUD line updates to 150ms to reduce frame drops from repeated recalculation. Updates stay on the render thread to avoid concurrent access. Requires MiniHUD.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.thir: Shows your own name in third-person (back/front) view. First-person, invisible, spectator and hidden-HUD states keep vanilla behavior.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.thro: Throws spawn eggs like eggs or snowballs; the mob spawns where the projectile hits a block or entity. Targeting a spawner only configures its type without consuming the egg. Single-player/LAN only.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.snow: Warm or dry biome attributes no longer melt snow golems. Rain, water and lava damage still work as in vanilla. Melting is server-authoritative, so this only works in single-player or LAN worlds.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.came: Camera motion inspired by CameraOverhaul: tilts while turning/strafing, pitch when moving forward/backward or jumping/falling, gentle sway while idle, screen shakes from explosions/lightning/hand swings, and optional mouse smoothing. Each effect can be toggled below.
Intensity percentage for all camera motion effects (0 ~ 200); 100 is the default. Set to 0 to temporarily disable every effect.
The camera gently rolls toward the direction you turn.
The camera gently rolls toward the direction you strafe.
The camera pitches down slightly when moving forward and up when moving backward.
The camera pitches up when jumping/rising and down when falling.
After you stop moving and turning for a while, the camera sways gently. Any movement, turning or hand swing ends it immediately.
Adds short camera shakes for explosions, lightning strikes and hand swings; weaker with distance.
Smooths fast camera turns visually. Rendering only; actual aiming is unchanged.
Apply camera motion effects in first person. Off by default to avoid motion sickness.
Apply camera motion effects in third-person (back/front) view.
tweakify-mod.config.general.comment.item: Folds similar items in creative category tabs (stairs, slabs, wool, potions, etc.) into one group icon. Click the icon to expand or collapse; the search tab stays vanilla.
How items are ordered inside a group: keep the original tab order, or sort by item ID alphabetically.
